title: Meaning, Soul and Afterlife
welcome_lead: What is the meaning of life — and what happens after we die?
meta_desc: KS3 Religious Studies adventure on the meaning of life, the soul and the afterlife.
final_note: You can now compare different religious views on the soul and what comes next.

concepts.def: Spiritual part of a person, often immortal.
Place of reward with God in Abrahamic faiths.
Rebirth of the soul in a new body.
Buddhist goal: end of suffering and rebirth.

walkthroughs.body_html: Religions answer 'what is life for?' in different ways. Christians, Muslims and Jews often say life is about loving and serving God. Hindus aim to escape the cycle of rebirth. Buddhists seek to end suffering. Atheists may make their own meaning.

Many religions teach we have a soul — a spiritual part of us that goes beyond the body. In Christianity, Islam and Judaism the soul lives on after death. In Hinduism, the soul (atman) moves into new bodies through reincarnation.

Christians and Muslims often believe in Heaven and Hell based on how you lived. Jews focus more on this life but many also believe in an afterlife. Hindus and Buddhists believe in reincarnation, with the ultimate goal of escaping it (moksha or Nirvana).
